STAGES:
  Every stage reads source given with -e EXPR or as a FILE path and
  prints deterministic text; each runs the earlier stages first:
    lex     token stream with byte spans
    render  decorated Unicode form; --raw converts decorated text
            back to source, --latex prints LaTeX math, --color
            highlights it for a terminal (tolerating errors)
    parse   surface tree as S-expressions (at most one reading;
            ambiguous shapes are errors)
    fmt     canonical, fully parenthesized form
    core    Core IR after desugaring (built-ins marked #)
    type    inferred type of each top-level item
    eval    type-check, then evaluate; prints each top-level
            expression's value (--untyped skips the checker)
    run     type-check and run a .xtl script (also: xetal FILE, for
            #! scripts; --untyped skips the checker; --echo shows each
            statement pretty-printed, then its output)
    diagram an annotated SVG of a line of source, from a notes file
            (== SOURCE, == TITLE, == NOTE anchor sections)
    edit    full-screen editor for a FILE: ASCII on the left, the
            live decorated and highlighted view on the right, types
            and errors below as you type; Ctrl-R runs, Ctrl-S saves,
            Ctrl-Q quits, Tab moves between panes, Ctrl-T zooms one
    repl    interactive session reading lines from stdin: definitions
            and types persist, a failing line is dropped, an unclosed
            bracket continues on the next line
  eval and run take --seed N (or the XETAL_SEED environment variable)
  to repeat the random rolls of r_oll!; without one they differ.
  A built-in that is not implemented yet is error[unsupported].
  Errors and warnings print as error[CODE] / warning[CODE] on stderr.

EXAMPLES:
  xetal eval -e '1 + 2'
  xetal eval -e 'u:s_quare := { _r * _r }; u:s_quare 7'
  xetal lex -e 'u:s_quare := { _r * _r }; u:s_quare 7'
  xetal type -e 'u:s_quare := { _r * _r }'
  xetal render -e 'o_-_12 x^2'
  xetal render --latex -e 'o_-_12 x^2'
  xetal run demos/factorial.xtl
  xetal run --untyped demos/fixed-point.xtl

AI CODING AGENT INSTRUCTIONS:
  1. The language is defined by its tests: spec/**/*.case (run by
     `cargo test`), crate tests, and reg-rs baselines in reg/; the
     decisions behind them are in docs/lang-choices.md.
  2. Check one expression at every stage with
       xetal lex -e EXPR; xetal parse -e EXPR; xetal core -e EXPR;
       xetal type -e EXPR; xetal eval -e EXPR
  3. Ambiguous source is an error, never resolved by guessing. Errors
     print as error[CODE]: MESSAGE at START..END on stderr.
  4. Run scripts/gate.sh (fmt, clippy, tests, reg-rs, sw-checklist,
     markdown) before claiming a change is done.
